text:
dmitri: idea: policy-driven write-steering using short-lived consent tokens + lightweight escrow handshake for PII tenants. aim: active/active routing without strict geo-locks.
kevin: can you outline handshake? how is "escrow" different from prior notes?
maya: escrow = signed consent token (control-plane). dataplane checks token and decides to serve or forward. minimal state, no bulk transfer.
dmitri: token fields: tenant_id, resident_region, expiry, decay_ttl, model_region_allowlist, sig. proxies accept if token valid or if last-seen token within decay window. after decay -> control-plane lookup.
nash: token-expiry split-brain risk?
dmitri: mitigate with decay_ttl + prefer-local-with-grace. decay configurable per-tenant: strict(0s), preferred(30s), permissive(300s).
kevin: audit requirement: log any cross-region write with reason.
maya: emit event "write_routing_decision": tenant, req_id, origin_region, routed_region, reason(token|decay|fallback).
ops-bot: infra: proxies must verify signatures locally; maintain public-key cache and fallback to control-plane on miss.
nash: crypto: use ECDSA and include tenant KMS fingerprint for revocation.
kevin: perf: control-plane fallbacks add latency; ensure key cache hit >99.9%.
maya: rollout: lab sims -> permissive canary -> admin-gated strict.
dmitri: spike to validate cache assumptions next week unless objections.
ops-bot: reminder: create feature-flag before canary.
